svg.title: Deletion and retention
svg.desc: Deleting a video or all account data hides it at once, then the CPU worker removes each file after its grace period, verifies it is gone, releases quota, removes records and keeps a minimal tombstone.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Tombstone and deletion intent: hidden at once, jobs cancelled, no new grants, 202

span.p: Wait for grace periods: source about 72 h, generated files 24 h, issued reads 5 min
